hero.subtitle: Rooted in craft. Sculpted for tomorrow. A modern Indian couture house redefining the architecture of the drape.

about.title: The
about.description: Based in Mumbai, Advait Studio is built on the foundation of Indian textile heritage and contemporary tailoring. We explore the tension between structure and fluidity—working with master artisans to reinvent the saree, hand-embroidered silks, and modern bridal couture for a global audience.

timeline.title: Studio Inception
timeline.description: Founded in a quiet lane in South Mumbai, focusing on structural experimentation with handwoven Banarasi textiles.

timeline.title: The First Drape
timeline.description: Introduced our signature pre-stitched conceptual saree, gaining recognition from independent fashion editorials.

timeline.title: Contemporary Bridal
timeline.description: Launched the modern bridal couture line, blending Zardozi craftsmanship with minimalist architectural silhouettes.
